consensus_strengths: All reviews agree that the finite-pool, single-recorded-decode estimand is carefully bounded and that the displayed arithmetic is internally consistent.
The submission clearly distinguishes the natural-strata and paired-filler records and avoids unsupported causal, calibration, decoder-average, or cross-record inferences.
The transparent source-reported/cannot-verify labeling, anonymity, and concise presentation are strengths.
consensus_weaknesses: Neither central source record is traceable to immutable primary artifacts; treatment, sample construction, score construction, rows/traces, and analyses cannot be independently verified.
The opaque commit-score definition prevents substantive interpretation of the score-minus-correctness quantity beyond a conditional transcription.
The verified contribution is a narrow evidentiary/formal audit, not yet a reproducible empirical finding or demonstrated reusable method.

material_disagreements.topic: Whether the current bounded audit warrants a 2 or 4, and whether its evidence ceiling is 2 or 4.
positions: Novelty reviewer: the lack of a new verified empirical or general methodological contribution limits both score and ceiling to 2.
Other reviewers: the formal boundary and arithmetic audit support a marginal-below score and ceiling of 4 despite inaccessible empirical records.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Assign 4: the formal contribution is real but insufficient for acceptance; retain a ceiling of 4 until primary evidence or a demonstrated reusable method is supplied.

material_disagreements.topic: Whether a general audit framework or multiple accessible case studies are required.
positions: Novelty reviewer requests a reusable framework with demonstrated application if source artifacts remain unavailable.
Other reviewers identify an immutable reproduction bundle for the two claimed records as the smallest decisive remedy.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Prioritize reproducibility of the existing two records; require a general framework only if the paper continues to claim a broader methodological contribution.

unsupported_reviewer_claims.reason: The alleged mismatch between a PDF statement about an authoring directory and the frozen manifest cannot be verified from the permitted meta-review inputs because the PDF is outside scope; it should not affect the decision.

prioritized_actions.description: Release immutable, reviewer-safe A32-E1/E2 archives with stable crosswalks, manifests, rows, overlap information, and scripts that regenerate both tables.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A clean reviewer can regenerate Tables 2–3 and verify the stated sample relationship from archived artifacts alone.

prioritized_actions.description: Specify and release the score readout, token-to-item aggregation, correctness matcher, filler/tokenizer fixture, and frozen decode protocol; add replay or multi-realization analysis only for claims beyond a stored realization.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Released traces and code reproduce sampled item scores, labels, pairing, token dose, and reported aggregates.

prioritized_actions.description: Keep the contribution explicitly as a limited audit of an inaccessible source record; do not describe it as empirical evidence or a general method absent the artifacts above.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: All contribution and conclusion language matches the conditional, transcription-only evidence boundary.

prioritized_actions.description: Complete citation provenance and, if broader novelty is retained, provide a verified closest-work comparison.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Each in-text citation and novelty comparison has a verified local-support record; the source records have distinct archival provenance.

must_resolve_before_accept: Reproducible provenance and reconstruction for both central source records.
Operational definition and reproducible construction of the commit score and outcome matching.
A contribution supported by the released evidence, rather than an unverified transcription.
score_gaming_suggestions_to_reject: Do not raise claims of novelty, calibration relevance, treatment effects, or decoder robustness without new verifiable evidence.
Do not treat repeated cannot-verify disclaimers, formatting polish, or stronger certainty language as substitutes for reproducibility.
Do not average away the contribution concern or cite the review majority as evidence of validity.
decision_rationale: All five reviews match the stated snapshot. The defensible contribution is the careful conditional formalization and arithmetic audit, but its central empirical premises remain cannot_verify, not disproven. That supports a marginal-below 4 rather than rejection-level 2, while the absence of primary artifacts and a demonstrated broader contribution caps the present evidence at 4.
